name: git
install_cmd: if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y git; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf install -y git; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then yum install -y git; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then pacman -S --noconfirm git; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then apk add git; else echo ' unsupported package manager — install git manually' && exit 1; fi

name: vim
install_cmd: if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y vim; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf install -y vim-enhanced; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then yum install -y vim-enhanced; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then pacman -S --noconfirm vim; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then apk add vim; else echo ' unsupported package manager — install vim manually' && exit 1; fi

name: libatomic1
install_cmd: if ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -q libatomic; then exit 0; fi; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y libatomic1; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf install -y libatomic; elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then yum install -y libatomic; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then pacman -S --noconfirm gcc-libs; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then apk add libatomic; else echo ' unsupported package manager — install libatomic1 manually' && exit 1; fi

name: asdf
description: Polyglot version manager for Node.js, Python, Go, and other tools

name: asdf nodejs
install_cmd: asdf plugin add nodejs https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs.git && NODE_VERSION=$(curl -s https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json | grep -o '"version":"v[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*"version":"v([^"]+)".*/\1/') && asdf install nodejs $NODE_VERSION && asdf set -u nodejs $NODE_VERSION && asdf reshim nodejs
